name: progress
title: Progress
description: Progress bar built on the native progress element, with a label, percentage, and indeterminate mode.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value. null makes the progress indeterminate with a pulse animation.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the bar, linked with label for. The percentage shows on the right when value is set.

a11y: Uses the native progress element, so the progressbar role and its value are exposed automatically.
The label is linked with label for. Without a label, set aria-label.
The indeterminate animation is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.whenToUse: Showing the progress of a measurable process, such as a file upload or onboarding steps.
rules: Leave value empty when the duration is unknown
Always provide a label or aria-label
For placeholders of loading content use Skeleton

id.description: Bilah kemajuan berbasis elemen progress native dengan label, persentase, dan mode tak tentu.

props.value: Nilai saat ini. null membuat progress tak tentu (indeterminate) dengan animasi denyut.
props.label: Label di atas bilah, dihubungkan lewat label for. Persentase tampil di kanan bila value terisi.

a11y: Memakai elemen progress native, jadi role progressbar dan nilainya terbaca otomatis.
Label terhubung lewat label for. Tanpa label, isi aria-label.
Animasi mode tak tentu dimatikan saat prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.whenToUse: Menampilkan kemajuan proses yang terukur seperti unggah berkas atau langkah onboarding.
rules: Biarkan value kosong bila durasi proses tidak diketahui
Untuk placeholder konten yang sedang dimuat gunakan Skeleton
